abilities.name: Ceremonial Bladework
_curatorNotes: Normal hits N1–N4: ActionCharge is not explicitly set in gcsim attackFrames — defaults to AnimationLength via InitNormalCancelSlice second arg (30/25/47/46 respectively); C key omitted from all non-final normal hits.

N5: ActionCharge=500 is explicitly set but gcsim source comment says 'this action is illegal; need better way to handle it' — omitted. ActionAttack (N) defaults to AnimationLength=64 via InitNormalCancelSlice, not explicitly overridden — omitted.

plungeFrames: gcsim has separate lowPlungeFrames (hitmark=45, swap=64) and highPlungeFrames (hitmark=47, swap=67); using lowPlunge values here. High plunge frames: swap=67, N=56, E=57, Q=56, D=47 — not represented.
plungeFrames.J: ActionJump is InitAbilSlice(74) default (AnimationLength) in lowPlungeFrames — not explicitly set, omitted.

abilities.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

abilities.name: Glacial Waltz
_curatorNotes: C2 (Never-Ending Performance): duration extends +2.5s per kill during burst (max 15s, up to 3 extensions) — this is runtime-dynamic and cannot be represented as static durationModifiers. Reviewer to decide modeling approach.
gcsim burst frames ActionSkill (E) = 78 is AnimationLength default from InitAbilSlice(78) — not explicitly set, omitted.
abilities.description:
Coalescing the frost in the air, Kaeya summons 3 icicles that revolve around him.
These icicles will follow the character around and deal Cryo DMG to opponents in their path for the ability's duration.

passives.name: Cold-Blooded Strike
_curatorNotes: Migrated to onHit ability:skill 2026-05-09 (F1). Fires from Frostgnaw E skill hit; 15% ATK self-heal.
passives.description: Every hit with Frostgnaw regenerates HP for Kaeya equal to 15% of his ATK.

passives.name: Glacial Heart
passives.description:
Opponents Frozen by Frostgnaw will drop additional Elemental Particles.
Frostgnaw may only produce a maximum of 2 additional Elemental Particles per use.

constellations.name: Excellent Blood
_curatorNotes: Conditional buff — activates only when target is affected by Cryo aura or is Frozen (checked at hit time in gcsim via AuraContains); applies to Normal and Charged Attacks only. Inherited manual trigger — reviewer to update trigger and add conditional aura check.
constellations.description: The CRIT Rate of Kaeya's Normal and Charge Attacks against opponents affected by Cryo is increased by 15%.

constellations.name: Never-Ending Performance
constellations.description: While Glacial Waltz is in effect, for each opponent defeated, its duration is increased by 2.5s, up to a maximum of 15s.

constellations.name: Dance of Frost
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Frostgnaw by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Frozen Kiss
_curatorNotes: 2026-05-09 model-mismatch cleanup: rewrote the effect from `damage hp 30 target:enemy` to `shield self hp 30 duration:20`. The 250% Cryo absorption efficiency is not modelled (no per-element shield-efficiency primitive). Trigger remains `manual`: activates when HP falls below 20% with a 60s ICD — no enemy-side / self-HP-trigger primitive matches; reviewer to wire when one lands.
constellations.description:
Triggers automatically when Kaeya's HP falls below 20%:
Creates a shield that absorbs damage equal to 30% of Kaeya's Max HP. Lasts for 20s.
This shield absorbs Cryo DMG with 250% efficiency.
Can only occur once every 60s.
